(a) Is f an increasing or decreasing function of:

A?
?
increasing
decreasing
neither increasing nor decreasing
somtimes increasing and sometimes decreasing

?

(b) Interpret the statement f(1250, 3.25, 32) \approx 2974 by writing a sentence, including units. Then use your sentence to complete the following:

The units of 1250 are:
?
percent
months
dollars
dollars/month

p.em: (Note because this is all multiple choice, you will not see which parts of the problem are correct.)

static.solution:
(a) We expect B to be an increasing function of all three variables.
(b) A deposit of 1250 dollars at a 3.25 % annual interest rate for 32 months results in a balance of 2974 dollars.
